subject: Computação
description_pt: Identificar os impactos ambientais do descarte de peças de computadores e eletrônicos, bem como sua relação com a sustentabilidade. Selecionar e utilizar tecnologias computacionais para se expressar e resolver problemas, analisando criticamente os diferentes impactos na sociedade.

components.description_pt: Identificar impactos ambientais do descarte inadequado de componentes de computadores e eletrônicos
components.description_en: Identify the environmental impacts of improper disposal of computer and electronic components
components.cc_component_description: Explain the causal relationship between specific human lifestyle choices and their environmental impacts

components.description_pt: Explicar a relação entre descarte de resíduos eletrônicos e sustentabilidade
components.description_en: Explain the relationship between electronic waste disposal and sustainability
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate human resource management practices based on their impact on biodiversity and sustainability

components.description_pt: Analisar impactos sociais diversos de tecnologias computacionais em comunidades e sociedade
components.description_en: Analyze diverse social impacts of computational technologies on communities and society
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a proposed solution by weighing its social, cultural, and environmental impacts alongside technical criteria

cc_matches.description: Things that people do to live comfortably can affect the world around them. But they can make choices that reduce their impacts on the land, water, air, and other living things.
The sustainability of human societies and the biodiversity that supports them requires responsible management of natural resources.
When evaluating solutions it is important to take into account a range of constraints including cost, safety, reliability and aesthetics and to consider social, cultural and environmental impacts.
